title: Evaluation case z2-licence-question: a licensing question with no failure in it
scenario: A licensing question with no failure in it.

events.title: Licences for phone calls
events.text: Which licence do our sales staff need to make and receive phone calls in Teams, and can we limit which external guests are allowed to join our meetings?

events.title: Re: Licences for phone calls
events.text: Phone calls need a Teams Phone licence plus either a calling plan or direct routing. Guests can be limited in the Teams admin centre under external access, either to named domains or to none.

events.title: Re: Licences for phone calls
events.text: That answers it, thank you. We will assign the licences next week.
